cards.meaning: surrender; submitting oneself to authority; also giving up
cards.example: Hindi magkakaroon ng hurisdiksiyon ang korte hangga't walang pagsuko ang kongresista.
cards.exampleMeaning: The court will have no jurisdiction until the congressman surrenders.
cards.note: Mula sa ugat na 'suko'. May dalawang gamit: pag-abot sa awtoridad at pagtanggap ng pagkatalo. Mas mabigat kaysa 'pagharap'. Madalas: pagsuko sa pulisya, pagsuko sa NBI.
cards.tiesTo: Leviste abroad; court jurisdiction awaits surrender

cards.example: Nagtaas ng pagtutol ang depensa sa tanong tungkol sa mga account sa ibang bansa.
cards.exampleMeaning: The defense raised an objection to the question about the foreign accounts.
cards.note: Pormal na rehistro; maririnig sa korte at Kongreso. Tindig na may batayan, mas matatag kaysa 'hindi pagkakasundo'. Kasingkahulugan: pagsalungat (mas malawak, pampulitika).
cards.tiesTo: Impeachment court blocks BPI foreign-accounts query

cards.example: 房地产销售持续低迷，于是地方政府不得不重新考虑土地出让的节奏。
cards.examplePinyin: Fángdìchǎn xiāoshòu chíxù dīmí, yúshì dìfāng zhèngfǔ bùdébù chóngxīn kǎolǜ tǔdì chūràng de jiézòu.
cards.exampleMeaning: Property sales stayed depressed, so local governments had to rethink the pace of land sales.
cards.note: 书面语 but fine in speech. 于是 narrates a reaction in sequence ('and then what'); contrast 因此/所以 which state a logical result ('why').
cards.tiesTo: China property slump and local land-sale revenue

cards.meaning: up to now, to this day
cards.example: 北京的刺激措施偏重供给，至今仍未见到能明显拉动居民消费的举措。
cards.examplePinyin: Běijīng de cìjī cuòshī piānzhòng gōngjǐ, zhìjīn réng wèi jiàndào néng míngxiǎn lādòng jūmín xiāofèi de jǔcuò.
cards.exampleMeaning: Beijing's stimulus leans toward supply; to this day there is no measure that clearly lifts household consumption.
cards.note: 书面语. Spoken equivalent 到现在. Collocates with 仍, 没, 未 to stress an expected change hasn't arrived.
